videoLab.title: Product and store media recognition lab
videoLab.subtitle: No sign-in is needed in local development; administrators only in other environments. Upload video or photos to identify product, store, and promotion clues. Temporary media is deleted after processing; confirmed results can continue through the same plan, review, and outcome tracking workflow. Local recognition uses Codex CLI; cloud recognition uses the OpenAI API.
videoLab.videoLabel: Upload videos or photos (up to 5 files)
videoLab.videoHelp: Select multiple videos and photos at once, or add them one by one. Videos can be up to 3 minutes and 250 MB; JPG, PNG, and WebP photos up to 20 MB. Files are analyzed in order; one failure will not stop the others.
videoLab.chooseVideoHelp: Supports MP4, MOV, WebM video and JPG, PNG, WebP photos.
videoLab.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: store interior, salmon roll on lunch menu, store-wide sale
videoLab.unverifiedHint: Use this only as a clue. The merchant still needs to confirm product names, ingredients, prices, stock, and offers.
videoLab.factsLabel: Customer-provided product list, menu, or price list (optional)
videoLab.factsPlaceholder: Paste customer-confirmed product names, models, or price information. Do not add guesses.
videoLab.factsHelp: Used to check single-product content. Prices, models, stock, and offers still need customer-confirmed facts.
videoLab.processingHint: Videos are sampled into key frames; photos are analyzed as still images. Deduplicated video product candidates get an optimized image automatically; you can choose to optimize photo candidates from the results. Uploaded photos and temporary video files are cleaned up after processing.
videoLab.codexPlanUsage: Uses your Codex account plan; no per-call API estimate
videoLab.candidateNextStep: Repeated candidates are merged. Video product candidates get an optimized image automatically; photo candidates can be optimized when needed. Store or event candidates do not get product images and can continue into the same marketing plan.
videoLab.campaignCandidateNoImage: This is a store-wide or promotional scene, not one individual product. Background removal will not be applied; carry it into the marketing plan as a whole-campaign promotion.
videoLab.unclearCandidateNoImage: The product identity or purpose is unclear, so no product image will be generated yet. Confirm it in the marketing plan first.
videoLab.planEntryHelp: Open a dedicated planning page to plan offers for individual products or a store-wide promotion, then create a campaign calendar and post copy.
videoLab.planFormHelp: Recognized products are included. Add the information below to guide the marketing plan.
videoLab.planLocationPlaceholder: For example: downtown Toronto, within 10 km of the store
videoLab.planNotesPlaceholder: Add confirmed offers, budget, inventory, or other requirements. Mark uncertain details for review.
videoLab.planPageIntro: Create a marketing plan draft from recognized products and confirmed customer facts, including positioning, pricing and offers, a publishing calendar, and copy. Missing prices will not be invented.
videoLab.planActivityContextHelp: This is campaign-level material. The plan will promote the event as a whole and will not invent specific clothing styles. Confirm its coverage, discount, and exclusions.
videoLab.planActivityDiscountPlaceholder: For example: 20% or CAD $20; leave blank if unconfirmed
videoLab.planActivityTermsPlaceholder: For example: all clothing; whether sale items, shoes, or accessories are included; date and store limits
videoLab.planContextMissingTitle: This recognition result could not be found
videoLab.planContextMissingHelp: Recognition results are temporarily stored in this browser. Return to the lab, analyze the video again, then open the plan.
videoLab.generatedPlanMissingTitle: The generated marketing plan could not be found
videoLab.generatedPlanMissingHelp: Return to plan setup and generate the plan before opening its calendar.
videoLab.plan_dates_invalid: Choose a valid campaign start and end date. The end date must be on or after the start date.
videoLab.planProductFactsPlaceholder: Confirmed model, features, warranty, inventory, and similar details
videoLab.planBudgetPlaceholder: For example: CAD $300 total; leave blank for organic-only planning
videoLab.planPriceAccuracyHint: Prices and discounts use only the values you enter. Products without prices will be marked for confirmation, with non-numeric offer suggestions.
videoLab.sushiDemoNoticeTitle: Workflow example, not a real merchant plan
videoLab.sushiDemoNoticeBody: Images are bundled sushi demo assets, not a merchant's video or original photography. Dish names, ingredients, prices, allergens, hours, and offers need merchant confirmation. Replace these with the shop's own authorized assets before publishing.
videoLab.candidateProminence: Suitable for an individual post: {prominent} · Samples used: {frames}
videoLab.noCandidates: There is not enough evidence to group separate product candidates.
videoLab.opportunitiesHelp: What kind of post or video could be made from this clip.
videoLab.relationshipsHelp: How the listed products connect to each other or to the promotion.
videoLab.noRelationships: No clear bundle or promotion relationships were found.
videoLab.unverifiedHelp: On-screen text and speech are clues only. Do not publish them as facts about price, model, stock, or offers without customer confirmation.
videoLab.noAudio: This video has no audio track, so speech transcription was skipped.
videoLab.localTranscriptSkipped: Speech transcription is skipped in local Codex mode; recognition is based on video frames.
videoLab.needsProductList: Needs a customer product list for matching
